metadata.programme: BHQ Sovereign Quantum Computing and Networking / BIQOS
metadata.application_security_proof_doctrine: Ledger and blockchain presence alone is not application security proof. Every commitment is backed by mathematical application-level verification: ECDSA P-256 public key verification, canonical payload hashing, and Merkle inclusion proofs.

positive_tests.name: Valid Signed Contract Acceptance via Ingestion Pipeline (/verify)
MDU Execution Certificate with Merkle Proof (/evidence/certificate/{id})

negative_tests.name: In-Flight Payload Bit Tampering (shots: 1024 -> 1025)
negative_tests.injected_fault: Mutated payload shots from 1024 to 1025 after signing
negative_tests.halt_reason: HALT:INVALID_SIGNATURE:ECDSA signature verification failed — contract may be tampered

negative_tests.name: Forged / Corrupted ECDSA DER Signature Rejection
negative_tests.halt_reason: HALT:INVALID_SIGNATURE:ECDSA signature verification failed — contract may be tampered

negative_tests.name: Missing Public Key on Unregistered Producer
negative_tests.injected_fault: Passed empty string as public key
negative_tests.halt_reason: TRUST_REJECTED: Producer not registered and no valid public key provided

negative_tests.name: Missing Authorization Header on /gc/validate
negative_tests.injected_fault: Submitted request without Bearer authorization header
negative_tests.outcome: HTTPException(401, Missing or invalid Authorization header)

negative_tests.name: Non-Existent Certificate Retrieval (/evidence/certificate/{id})
negative_tests.outcome: HTTPException(404, Execution record not found in ledger)

Criterion_1_Valid_Contract_Acceptance.requirement: Authentic signed contract executes through /verify to COMPLETED with matching trace_id

Criterion_2_Replay_Protection.requirement: Duplicate trace_id submission rejected by CanonicalReplayAuthority with REPLAY_DUPLICATE_REJECTED

Criterion_3_Tamper_and_Forgery_Rejection.requirement: Single-bit payload mutation and forged DER signatures rejected with HALTED

Criterion_4_Evidence_and_Merkle_Proof.requirement: MDU execution certificate issued with Merkle root and verified lineage

Criterion_5_Governance_and_Auth_Enforcem.requirement: Constitutional /gc/validate flow enforces Bearer header; missing key halts with TRUST_REJECTED
